text: maria: Heads up — reproducibility flake in the infra-tools builder images. Digest gate failing intermittently across CI runs, SBOMs differ even when Dockerfile and deps are unchanged. Anyone else seeing this or have quick ideas? :eyes: ci-bot: build infra-tools:latest #482 failed: digest mismatch expected: sha256:9f3a... got: sha256:1b7c... (artifact: sbom.json, image-manifest.json) tom: ugh. last deploy that touched the builder image? any steps that embed timestamps/git metadata? maria: no functional changes. dug into a few runs — looks like BuildKit/registry manifest ordering + unpinned base images cause layer ordering diffs. also our SBOM generator emits unordered arrays so content diffs even when packages same. ben: interesting. we should probably: pin base images by digest, set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, and capture an LLB manifest/lockfile from buildkit to assert same build plan. maria: yup. prototype Dockerfile snippet I used locally: ```Dockerfile FROM alpine@sha256:3a8f... ENV SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1672531200 COPY --chown=1000:1000 files/ /app/files/ RUN find /app/files -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -I{} sh -c 'cat "{}" > "{}"' ``` that plus `buildctl build --metadata-file=meta.json --export-cache=type=inline` gives me a repeatable image locally. but CI needs to do this reproducibly across workers. jen: on SBOM side: syft/sbom-gen is emitting lists in non-deterministic order. quick fix is to normalize with jq: `syft -o json | jq -S . > sbom.json` — jq -S sorts object keys but also helps make outputs stable. also enable cyclonedx output if needed. ryan: to add to ben's idea: propose CI change: new job `image-lock` that: - pins base by digest (resolve during PR) - sets SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH in build args - runs buildctl to export LLB / metadata (artifact: image.llb.json) - generates sbom and normalizes with jq - compares llb + sbom against last promoted artifact before publish if mismatch, fail promotion. maria: sounds good. I'll draft the GH Actions workflow patch: add a step to fetch base digest (`skopeo inspect docker://alpine:3.18 | jq -r .Digest`) and replace Dockerfile FROM via simple sed during CI, then build with buildctl and save meta.json + llb.json as artifacts. also add sbom normalizer. ben: also consider signing the llb/meta with cosign so we can verify provenance in ops. maria: good call — will add cosign signing of meta.json as part of publish job. ci-bot: created issue #1257: "reproducible infra-builder images: llb lock + sbom normalization" and scheduled nightly repro job. maria: thanks — I'll open the PR and tag you all. planning to ship the workflow changes + gating within this sprint. :rocket: tom: 👍 much needed. jen: thanks, will update sbom injector to ensure jq normalization in the pipeline. ben: if you want I can prototype the buildctl -> llb extraction steps in a branch. maria: pls do, thanks!
